name: zenmoney
description: Your finances in ChatGPT: automatic bank sync across the EU, plus daily, weekly and monthly briefs on what's changed, what's coming up and what needs your attention

interface.longDescription: Zenmoney is a personal finance app and expense tracker with automatic bank sync across the EU and Eastern Europe. Ask about your spending, budget and savings, add or edit transactions, and get daily, weekly and monthly briefs on what's changed, what's coming up and what needs your attention.
defaultPrompt: Give me my daily financial brief
Why am I running out of money faster than usual?
Can I afford a new laptop without dipping into my savings?

positive.description: Summarize yesterday's finances and upcoming payments.
positive.prompt: Give me my daily financial brief
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize yesterday's key financial events and near-term obligations, flagging possible duplicate charges and account shortfalls without changing records.

positive.description: Summarize the completed week and upcoming payments.
positive.prompt: Give me my weekly financial brief
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the completed Monday–Sunday week and upcoming obligations, including a completed-month overview when required by the Financial Brief skill.

positive.description: Summarize the completed financial month and upcoming obligations.
positive.prompt: Give me my monthly financial brief
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the completed financial month's income, spending and surplus, highlighting upcoming obligations and any funding gap before expected income arrives.

positive.description: Show account balances and a converted total.
positive.prompt: Show my account balances and total balance
positive.expected_behavior: List recorded balances in each account's currency and show a converted total with the treatment of archived accounts clearly stated.
List the latest actual transactions in descending date order with descriptions, amounts and account currencies, preserving separate entries and excluding scheduled payments.

negative.description: Handle a request to send a bank payment.
negative.prompt: Send £500 from my Revolut Card to my landlord.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that bank transfers are unsupported and direct the user to their bank without sending money or creating a substitute accounting entry.

negative.description: Handle a request to refresh a bank connection.
negative.prompt: Refresh my Revolut bank connection and download today’s transactions.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot refresh bank connections and direct the user to refresh the data in Zenmoney before requesting stored transactions again.

negative.description: Handle a request to dispute a charge and obtain a refund.
negative.prompt: Dispute the duplicate Uniqlo charge and get me a refund.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that disputes and refunds are unsupported, suggest checking the possible duplicate with Revolut or Uniqlo, and leave accounting records unchanged.
